description: This file is the __init__.py for the 'rendezvous' module within torch.distributed.elastic, importing and registering various rendezvous-related classes, errors, and handlers, and providing documentation on the rendezvous mechanism used in Torch Distributed Elastic.

classes.name: DynamicRendezvousHandler
classes.description: Implements the rendezvous mechanism for Torch Distributed Elastic, supporting backend-agnostic operation and handling of node coordination, fault tolerance, and shared key-value store management.

classes.name: C10dRendezvousBackend
classes.description: Backend implementation using a C10d store (default TCPStore) for rendezvous operations.

classes.name: EtcdRendezvousBackend
classes.description: Backend implementation using etcd for rendezvous operations, replacing legacy handler.

methods.name: from_backend
methods.description: Creates a DynamicRendezvousHandler instance from a specified backend, run ID, store, and node parameters.

calls: from .api import (rendezvous_handler_registry, RendezvousClosedError, RendezvousConnectionError, RendezvousError, RendezvousGracefulExitError, RendezvousHandler, RendezvousHandlerCreator, RendezvousHandlerRegistry, RendezvousInfo, RendezvousParameters, RendezvousStateError, RendezvousStoreInfo, RendezvousTimeoutError)
